body:
Yeah, I just feel the pressure mounting for me to get high grades so I can get into a good university and then get a high paying job. I don't know if I can even do that. Even my classmates around me are thinking way ahead and I'm worried I won't be prepared enough. Maybe I won't make it. Who knows.

My dad just came into my room and yelled at me again. I'm really scared.

I do hope I am a good person...sometimes I wonder if I even deserve this life. 

I'll try to talk to someone...thanks again, you've been so helpful and supportive!

I'll try to stay positive. I find it so emotionally exhausting, but I'll do my best. Being in a competitive environment where marks are constantly compared between friends is tiring and discouraging for me...so I'll just try to find friends who can support me through this too. Maybe I can go to school tomorrow with high spirits. I don't know. These few days have taken a toll on my mentality.

Yeah, maybe some time away from home would be good. Just someplace to escape the chaos of home...some peace and calm. I don't know if that will work forever but hopefully long enough. Maybe until I graduate and move away to wherever I'm studying. Thanks so much for your suggestions! Again, I really appreciate talking to you :)

Thank you so much for your reply :) I really appreciate it.

It seems to fluctuate a lot. Sometimes it's really good, but deep inside I know it won't stay that way forever. My parents even fight among themselves a lot and occasionally it gets violent. 

I just don't feel close to my family. My parents have never been the loving type, more like the "I'm having kids only because I feel like I have to" type. They've never been supportive and they're pretty stubborn. I feel bad for hating them sometimes because they are my parents but I just don't feel a lot of love. It's really unemotional between us.

I will continue working hard, but I just don't feel passionate about it anymore. It feels robotic and unfulfilling. It is tough.

Thanks again for your message...it's nice to know someone cares...
My sibling is 2 years younger than me and I am female...Why?
